---
title: "Live Session: Inequality, a Tale of Two Stories"
---

This page accompanies the inequality session of the **CDE Online International Bachelor and Master Winter School** *Co-designing pathways for transformative change* (session 7, 27 January 2026). The session follows the storyline of this module. Participants receive the slides via Slack.

## Before the session

::: {.callout-note}
## Preparation (about 2 hours)

1. Read the CDE Policy Brief [*Inequality: What's in a word?*](https://boris.unibe.ch/130698/) (Lannen 2019).
2. Work through chapter 1 of this module.
3. Complete the exercise [My inequality graph](../02_tale-of-two-stories/2_chapter.qmd#sec-my-graph) and post your graph with two or three sentences on the [Miro board](https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVEN0-B3o=/?share_link_id=815660152186).
:::

## After the session

- Muddiest points: questions posted in Slack are answered by the lecturer within a few days. Reply to your colleagues' questions in thread mode.
- Work through chapters 2 to 4 at your own pace. Nothing is graded.
- Explore the [Resources](../resources.qmd) page for videos, podcasts, and further reading.
